section \<open>Iterates of a map\<close>

lemma iter_Suc_app: "(f ^^ Suc n) z = f ((f ^^ n) z)"
  by (simp only: funpow.simps comp_apply)

lemma iter_fixed:
  assumes "f y = y"
  shows "(f ^^ k) y = y"
proof (induction k)
  case 0
  show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc k)
  have "(f ^^ Suc k) y = f ((f ^^ k) y)" by (rule iter_Suc_app)
  also have "\<dots> = f y" using Suc.IH by simp
  also have "\<dots> = y" by (rule assms)
  finally show ?case .
qed

lemma iter_back:
  assumes "(f ^^ Suc q) y = y"
  shows "y = (f ^^ q) (f y)"
proof -
  have "y = (f ^^ Suc q) y" by (rule assms[symmetric])
  also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ q) (f y)" by (simp only: funpow_Suc_right comp_apply)
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma gcd_closure:
  fixes Q :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" and a b :: nat
  assumes base: "\<And>m. Q m 0"
    and step: "\<And>m n. 0 < n \<Longrightarrow> Q n (m mod n) \<Longrightarrow> Q m n"
  shows "Q a b"
  by (rule gcd_nat_induct[where P = Q and m = a and n = b, OF base step])

section \<open>A fixed point of a prime-length cycle is the identity\<close>

lemma prime_orbit_fixed:
  fixes f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a" and x :: 'a and p m :: nat
  assumes pp: "prime p" and per: "(f ^^ p) x = x" and mm: "(f ^^ m) x = x"
    and m0: "0 < m" and mp: "m < p"
  shows "f x = x"
proof -
  have add_in: "\<And>a b. (f ^^ a) x = x \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ b) x = x \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ (a + b)) x = x"
  proof -
    fix a b :: nat
    assume ha: "(f ^^ a) x = x" and hb: "(f ^^ b) x = x"
    have "(f ^^ (a + b)) x = (f ^^ a) ((f ^^ b) x)" by (simp only: funpow_add comp_apply)
    also have "\<dots> = x" by (simp only: hb ha)
    finally show "(f ^^ (a + b)) x = x" .
  qed
  have sub_in: "\<And>a b. (f ^^ a) x = x \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ (a + b)) x = x \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ b) x = x"
  proof -
    fix a b :: nat
    assume ha: "(f ^^ a) x = x" and hab: "(f ^^ (a + b)) x = x"
    have "(f ^^ b) x = (f ^^ b) ((f ^^ a) x)" by (simp only: ha)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (b + a)) x" by (simp only: funpow_add comp_apply)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (a + b)) x" by (simp only: add.commute)
    also have "\<dots> = x" by (rule hab)
    finally show "(f ^^ b) x = x" .
  qed
  have mul_in: "\<And>a k. (f ^^ a) x = x \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ (k * a)) x = x"
  proof -
    fix a k :: nat
    assume ha: "(f ^^ a) x = x"
    show "(f ^^ (k * a)) x = x"
    proof (induction k)
      case 0
      show ?case by simp
    next
      case (Suc k)
      have "(f ^^ (Suc k * a)) x = (f ^^ (a + k * a)) x" by (simp only: mult_Suc)
      also have "\<dots> = x" by (rule add_in[OF ha Suc.IH])
      finally show ?case .
    qed
  qed
  have base_c: "\<And>m. (f ^^ m) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ 0) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ gcd m 0) x = x"
    by simp
  have step_c: "\<And>m n. 0 < n \<Longrightarrow>
      ((f ^^ n) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ (m mod n)) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ gcd n (m mod n)) x = x) \<Longrightarrow>
      ((f ^^ m) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ n) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ gcd m n) x = x)"
  proof -
    fix m n :: nat
    assume n0: "0 < n"
      and IH: "(f ^^ n) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ (m mod n)) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ gcd n (m mod n)) x = x"
    show "(f ^^ m) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ n) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ gcd m n) x = x"
    proof (intro impI)
      assume hm: "(f ^^ m) x = x" and hn: "(f ^^ n) x = x"
      have h1: "(f ^^ (m div n * n)) x = x" by (rule mul_in[OF hn])
      have h2: "(f ^^ (m div n * n + m mod n)) x = x" by (simp only: div_mult_mod_eq hm)
      have hmod: "(f ^^ (m mod n)) x = x" by (rule sub_in[OF h1 h2])
      have nz: "n \<noteq> 0" using n0 by simp
      have eqg: "gcd m n = gcd n (m mod n)" by (rule gcd_non_0_nat[OF nz])
      have "(f ^^ gcd n (m mod n)) x = x" using IH hn hmod by blast
      then show "(f ^^ gcd m n) x = x" by (simp only: eqg this)
    qed
  qed
  have gS: "(f ^^ gcd m p) x = x"
  proof -
    have "(f ^^ m) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ p) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ gcd m p) x = x"
      by (rule gcd_closure[where Q = "\<lambda>a b. (f ^^ a) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ b) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ gcd a b) x = x"
            and a = m and b = p, OF base_c step_c])
    then show ?thesis using mm per by blast
  qed
  have gd: "gcd m p dvd p" by (rule gcd_dvd2)
  have pdiv: "\<forall>d. d dvd p \<longrightarrow> d = 1 \<or> d = p" using pp by (simp add: prime_def)
  have gcd_cases: "gcd m p = 1 \<or> gcd m p = p" using pdiv gd by blast
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "gcd m p = 1")
    case True
    have "(f ^^ 1) x = x" using gS True by (metis)
    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case False
    then have gp: "gcd m p = p" using gcd_cases by blast
    have "p dvd m" using gcd_dvd1[of m p] gp by simp
    then have "p \<le> m" using m0 dvd_imp_le by blast
    then have False using mp by linarith
    then show ?thesis by blast
  qed
qed

section \<open>Orbit counting modulo a prime\<close>

lemma orbit_mod:
  fixes f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a" and p :: nat
  assumes pp: "prime p"
  shows "\<forall>n X. card X \<le> n \<longrightarrow> finite X \<longrightarrow> f ` X \<subseteq> X \<longrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x\<in>X. (f ^^ p) x = x) \<longrightarrow> card X mod p = card {x\<in>X. f x = x} mod p"
proof -
  have p2: "1 < p" using pp by (simp add: prime_def)
  obtain q where pq: "p = Suc q" using p2 by (cases p) auto
  show ?thesis
  proof (intro allI)
    fix n
    show "\<forall>X. card X \<le> n \<longrightarrow> finite X \<longrightarrow> f ` X \<subseteq> X \<longrightarrow>
        (\<forall>x\<in>X. (f ^^ p) x = x) \<longrightarrow> card X mod p = card {x\<in>X. f x = x} mod p"
    proof (induction n)
      case 0
      show ?case
      proof (intro allI impI)
        fix X
        assume cX: "card X \<le> 0" and fin: "finite X"
        then have "X = {}" by auto
        then show "card X mod p = card {x\<in>X. f x = x} mod p" by simp
      qed
    next
      case (Suc n)
      have ih: "\<forall>X. card X \<le> n \<longrightarrow> finite X \<longrightarrow> f ` X \<subseteq> X \<longrightarrow>
          (\<forall>x\<in>X. (f ^^ p) x = x) \<longrightarrow> card X mod p = card {x\<in>X. f x = x} mod p"
        using Suc.IH by blast
      show ?case
      proof (intro allI impI)
        fix X
        assume cX: "card X \<le> Suc n" and fin: "finite X" and sub: "f ` X \<subseteq> X"
          and per: "\<forall>x\<in>X. (f ^^ p) x = x"
        show "card X mod p = card {x\<in>X. f x = x} mod p"
        proof (cases "\<forall>x\<in>X. f x = x")
          case True
          then have "{x\<in>X. f x = x} = X" by blast
          then show ?thesis by simp
        next
          case False
          then obtain x where xX: "x \<in> X" and nfix: "f x \<noteq> x" by blast
          define O where "O = (\<lambda>i. (f ^^ i) x) ` {..<p}"
          have finO: "finite O" unfolding O_def by simp
          have px: "(f ^^ p) x = x" using per xX by blast
          have orb_in: "\<And>i. (f ^^ i) x \<in> X"
          proof -
            fix i
            show "(f ^^ i) x \<in> X"
            proof (induction i)
              case 0
              show ?case using xX by simp
            next
              case (Suc i)
              have "(f ^^ Suc i) x = f ((f ^^ i) x)" by (rule iter_Suc_app)
              then show ?case using Suc.IH sub by blast
            qed
          qed
          have no_fix: "\<And>i. i < p \<Longrightarrow> f ((f ^^ i) x) \<noteq> (f ^^ i) x"
          proof -
            fix i assume ip: "i < p"
            show "f ((f ^^ i) x) \<noteq> (f ^^ i) x"
            proof
              assume eq: "f ((f ^^ i) x) = (f ^^ i) x"
              have pe: "p - i + i = p" using ip by arith
              have hy: "(f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ i) x) = (f ^^ i) x" by (rule iter_fixed[OF eq])
              have s1: "(f ^^ p) x = (f ^^ ((p - i) + i)) x" by (simp only: pe)
              have s2: "(f ^^ ((p - i) + i)) x = (f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ i) x)"
                by (simp only: funpow_add comp_apply)
              have xi: "x = (f ^^ i) x" by (metis px s1 s2 hy)
              have "f x = f ((f ^^ i) x)" using xi by (rule arg_cong)
              also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ i) x" by (rule eq)
              also have "\<dots> = x" using xi by (rule sym)
              finally have "f x = x" .
              with nfix show False by blast
            qed
          qed
          have lt_ne: "\<And>i j. i < j \<Longrightarrow> j < p \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ i) x \<noteq> (f ^^ j) x"
          proof -
            fix i j :: nat
            assume ij: "i < j" and jp: "j < p"
            show "(f ^^ i) x \<noteq> (f ^^ j) x"
            proof
              assume eq: "(f ^^ i) x = (f ^^ j) x"
              have pj: "p - j + j = p" using jp by arith
              have B: "(f ^^ (p - j)) ((f ^^ j) x) = x"
              proof -
                have "(f ^^ (p - j)) ((f ^^ j) x) = (f ^^ ((p - j) + j)) x"
                  by (simp only: funpow_add comp_apply)
                also have "\<dots> = x" by (simp only: pj px)
                finally show ?thesis .
              qed
              have C: "(f ^^ (p - j)) ((f ^^ i) x) = (f ^^ (p - j + i)) x"
                by (simp only: funpow_add comp_apply)
              have D1: "(f ^^ (p - j)) ((f ^^ i) x) = (f ^^ (p - j)) ((f ^^ j) x)"
                by (simp only: eq)
              have D: "(f ^^ (p - j + i)) x = x" by (simp only: C[symmetric] D1 B)
              have m0: "0 < p - j + i" using jp by arith
              have mp: "p - j + i < p" using ij by arith
              have "f x = x" by (rule prime_orbit_fixed[OF pp px D m0 mp])
              with nfix show False by blast
            qed
          qed
          have inj_O: "inj_on (\<lambda>i. (f ^^ i) x) {..<p}"
          proof (rule inj_onI)
            fix i j assume hi: "i \<in> {..<p}" and hj: "j \<in> {..<p}"
              and eq: "(f ^^ i) x = (f ^^ j) x"
            have ip: "i < p" using hi by simp
            have jp: "j < p" using hj by simp
            show "i = j"
            proof (rule linorder_cases[of i j])
              assume "i < j"
              then have "(f ^^ i) x \<noteq> (f ^^ j) x" using lt_ne jp by blast
              with eq show ?thesis by contradiction
            next
              assume "i = j"
              then show ?thesis .
            next
              assume "j < i"
              then have "(f ^^ j) x \<noteq> (f ^^ i) x" using lt_ne ip by blast
              with eq show ?thesis by metis
            qed
          qed
          have cardO: "card O = p" unfolding O_def by (simp add: card_image inj_O)
          have O_sub: "O \<subseteq> X" unfolding O_def using orb_in by blast
          have fin_diff: "finite (X - O)" using fin by blast
          have eqU: "(X - O) \<union> O = X" using O_sub by blast
          have split: "card X = card (X - O) + p"
          proof -
            have "card X = card ((X - O) \<union> O)" using eqU by simp
            also have "\<dots> = card (X - O) + card O"
              by (rule card_Un_disjoint[OF fin_diff finO]) blast
            also have "\<dots> = card (X - O) + p" using cardO by simp
            finally show ?thesis .
          qed
          have not_fix_O: "\<And>y. y \<in> O \<Longrightarrow> f y \<noteq> y"
          proof -
            fix y assume "y \<in> O"
            then obtain i where ip: "i < p" and yi: "y = (f ^^ i) x"
              unfolding O_def by auto
            show "f y \<noteq> y" by (metis no_fix[OF ip] yi)
          qed
          have fix_eq: "{y \<in> X - O. f y = y} = {y \<in> X. f y = y}"
            using not_fix_O by blast
          have sub': "f ` (X - O) \<subseteq> X - O"
          proof
            fix z assume "z \<in> f ` (X - O)"
            then obtain y where yX: "y \<in> X" and yO: "y \<notin> O" and zfy: "z = f y"
              by auto
            have fyX: "z \<in> X" using sub yX zfy by blast
            have zO: "z \<notin> O"
            proof
              assume zO: "z \<in> O"
              then obtain i where ip: "i < p" and zi: "z = (f ^^ i) x"
                unfolding O_def by auto
              have yper: "(f ^^ p) y = y" using per yX by blast
              have yper': "(f ^^ Suc q) y = y" using yper pq by (simp only: pq[symmetric])
              have yback: "y = (f ^^ q) (f y)" by (rule iter_back[OF yper'])
              have fy: "f y = (f ^^ i) x" by (metis zfy zi)
              have yO': "y \<in> O"
              proof (cases i)
                case 0
                have "y = (f ^^ q) (f y)" by (rule yback)
                also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ q) x" using fy 0 by simp
                finally have yq: "y = (f ^^ q) x" .
                have qp: "q < p" using pq by arith
                have qmem: "q \<in> {..<p}" using qp by simp
                have hyq: "y = (\<lambda>i. (f ^^ i) x) q" using yq by simp
                show ?thesis unfolding O_def by (rule image_eqI[OF hyq qmem])
              next
                case (Suc i')
                have fy2: "f y = f ((f ^^ i') x)" using fy Suc by (simp only: Suc iter_Suc_app)
                have w: "(f ^^ Suc q) ((f ^^ i') x) = (f ^^ q) (f ((f ^^ i') x))"
                  by (simp only: funpow_Suc_right comp_apply)
                have i'p: "i' < p" using Suc ip by arith
                have mem': "(f ^^ i') x \<in> X" by (rule orb_in)
                have per_i': "(f ^^ p) ((f ^^ i') x) = (f ^^ i') x" using per mem' by blast
                have "y = (f ^^ q) (f y)" by (rule yback)
                also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ q) (f ((f ^^ i') x))" using fy2 by simp
                also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ Suc q) ((f ^^ i') x)" by (simp only: w)
                also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ p) ((f ^^ i') x)" by (simp only: pq[symmetric])
                also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ i') x" by (rule per_i')
                finally have yi': "y = (f ^^ i') x" .
                have qm: "i' \<in> {..<p}" using i'p by simp
                have hyi: "y = (\<lambda>i. (f ^^ i) x) i'" using yi' by simp
                show ?thesis unfolding O_def by (rule image_eqI[OF hyi qm])
              qed
              show False using yO yO' by blast
            qed
            show "z \<in> X - O" using fyX zO by blast
          qed
          have per': "\<forall>x\<in>X - O. (f ^^ p) x = x" using per by blast
          have le_n: "card (X - O) \<le> n" using split cX p2 by linarith
          have ih_app: "card (X - O) mod p = card {y \<in> X - O. f y = y} mod p"
            using ih le_n fin_diff sub' per' by blast
          have "card X mod p = card (X - O) mod p" using split by simp
          also have "\<dots> = card {y \<in> X - O. f y = y} mod p" by (rule ih_app)
          also have "\<dots> = card {y \<in> X. f y = y} mod p" by (simp only: fix_eq)
          finally show ?thesis .
        qed
      qed
    qed
  qed
qed

section \<open>Group facts derived from the basic axioms\<close>

context grp
begin

lemma idem_unit:
  assumes uG: "u \<in> G" and uu: "u \<cdot> u = u"
  shows "u = e"
proof -
  have h1: "ginv u \<cdot> u = e" by (rule left_inv[OF uG])
  have h2: "(ginv u \<cdot> u) \<cdot> u = ginv u \<cdot> (u \<cdot> u)"
    by (rule assoc[OF inv_closed[OF uG] uG uG])
  have "u = e \<cdot> u" by (rule left_unit[OF uG, symmetric])
  also have "\<dots> = (ginv u \<cdot> u) \<cdot> u" by (simp only: h1)
  also have "\<dots> = ginv u \<cdot> (u \<cdot> u)" by (rule h2)
  also have "\<dots> = ginv u \<cdot> u" by (simp only: uu)
  also have "\<dots> = e" by (rule h1)
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma rinv:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G"
  shows "x \<cdot> ginv x = e"
proof -
  have yG: "ginv x \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF xG])
  have yx: "ginv x \<cdot> x = e" by (rule left_inv[OF xG])
  have xyG: "x \<cdot> ginv x \<in> G" by (rule closed[OF xG yG])
  have step1: "ginv x \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x) = ginv x"
  proof -
    have "ginv x \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x) = (ginv x \<cdot> x) \<cdot> ginv x"
      by (rule assoc[OF yG xG yG, symmetric])
    also have "\<dots> = e \<cdot> ginv x" by (simp only: yx)
    also have "\<dots> = ginv x" by (rule left_unit[OF yG])
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  have idem: "(x \<cdot> ginv x) \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x) = x \<cdot> ginv x"
  proof -
    have "(x \<cdot> ginv x) \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x) = x \<cdot> (ginv x \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x))"
      by (rule assoc[OF xG yG xyG])
    also have "\<dots> = x \<cdot> ginv x" by (simp only: step1)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  show ?thesis by (rule idem_unit[OF xyG idem])
qed

lemma runit:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G"
  shows "x \<cdot> e = x"
proof -
  have yG: "ginv x \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF xG])
  have "x \<cdot> e = x \<cdot> (ginv x \<cdot> x)" by (simp only: left_inv[OF xG])
  also have "\<dots> = (x \<cdot> ginv x) \<cdot> x" by (rule assoc[OF xG yG xG, symmetric])
  also have "\<dots> = e \<cdot> x" by (simp only: rinv[OF xG])
  also have "\<dots> = x" by (rule left_unit[OF xG])
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma unique_inv:
  assumes PG: "P \<in> G" and zG: "z \<in> G" and hPz: "P \<cdot> z = e"
  shows "z = ginv P"
proof -
  have "z = e \<cdot> z" by (rule left_unit[OF zG, symmetric])
  also have "\<dots> = (ginv P \<cdot> P) \<cdot> z" by (simp only: left_inv[OF PG])
  also have "\<dots> = ginv P \<cdot> (P \<cdot> z)" by (rule assoc[OF inv_closed[OF PG] PG zG])
  also have "\<dots> = ginv P \<cdot> e" by (simp only: hPz)
  also have "\<dots> = ginv P" by (rule runit[OF inv_closed[OF PG]])
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma pow_Suc_mul: "pow x (Suc n) = x \<cdot> pow x n"
  by simp

lemma pow_e: "pow e n = e"
  by (induction n) (simp_all add: left_unit unit_closed)

lemma pow_iter: "(mult a ^^ n) e = pow a n"
  by (induction n) simp_all

section \<open>Products of lists\<close>

definition lprod :: "'a list \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "lprod xs = foldr mult xs e"

lemma lprod_Nil [simp]: "lprod [] = e"
  by (simp add: lprod_def)

lemma lprod_Cons [simp]: "lprod (y # ys) = y \<cdot> lprod ys"
  by (simp add: lprod_def)

lemma lprod_mem:
  assumes "set xs \<subseteq> G"
  shows "lprod xs \<in> G"
  using assms
proof (induction xs)
  case Nil
  show ?case by (simp add: unit_closed)
next
  case (Cons y ys)
  have yG: "y \<in> G" using Cons.prems by auto
  have ysG: "set ys \<subseteq> G" using Cons.prems by auto
  have ihG: "lprod ys \<in> G" using Cons.IH ysG by blast
  have "y \<cdot> lprod ys \<in> G" by (rule closed[OF yG ihG])
  then show ?case by simp
qed

lemma lprod_snoc:
  assumes zG: "z \<in> G"
  shows "\<forall>ys. set ys \<subseteq> G \<longrightarrow> lprod (ys @ [z]) = lprod ys \<cdot> z"
proof (rule allI)
  fix ys
  show "set ys \<subseteq> G \<longrightarrow> lprod (ys @ [z]) = lprod ys \<cdot> z"
  proof (induction ys)
    case Nil
    show ?case by (simp add: zG runit left_unit)
  next
    case (Cons y ys)
    show ?case
    proof (rule impI)
      assume sub: "set (y # ys) \<subseteq> G"
      have yG: "y \<in> G" using sub by auto
      have ysG: "set ys \<subseteq> G" using sub by auto
      have Pg: "lprod ys \<in> G" by (rule lprod_mem[OF ysG])
      have ih: "lprod (ys @ [z]) = lprod ys \<cdot> z" using Cons.IH ysG by blast
      have "lprod ((y # ys) @ [z]) = y \<cdot> lprod (ys @ [z])" by simp
      also have "\<dots> = y \<cdot> (lprod ys \<cdot> z)" using ih by simp
      also have "\<dots> = (y \<cdot> lprod ys) \<cdot> z" by (rule assoc[OF yG Pg zG, symmetric])
      also have "\<dots> = lprod (y # ys) \<cdot> z" by simp
      finally show "lprod ((y # ys) @ [z]) = lprod (y # ys) \<cdot> z" .
    qed
  qed
qed

lemma lprod_cancel:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G" and PG: "lprod ys \<in> G" and hx: "x \<cdot> lprod ys = e"
  shows "lprod ys \<cdot> x = e"
proof -
  have "lprod ys = ginv x"
  proof -
    have "lprod ys = e \<cdot> lprod ys" by (rule left_unit[OF PG, symmetric])
    also have "\<dots> = (ginv x \<cdot> x) \<cdot> lprod ys" by (simp only: left_inv[OF xG])
    also have "\<dots> = ginv x \<cdot> (x \<cdot> lprod ys)" by (rule assoc[OF inv_closed[OF xG] xG PG])
    also have "\<dots> = ginv x \<cdot> e" by (simp only: hx)
    also have "\<dots> = ginv x" by (rule runit[OF inv_closed[OF xG]])
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  then show ?thesis by (simp only: this left_inv[OF xG])
qed

lemma lprod_replicate: "lprod (replicate n a) = pow a n"
  by (induction n) simp_all

section \<open>Rotation of lists\<close>

lemma rotate_lprod:
  assumes "set xs \<subseteq> G" and "xs \<noteq> []" and "lprod xs = e"
  shows "lprod (rotate1 xs) = e"
proof -
  obtain x ys where xs: "xs = x # ys" using assms(2) by (cases xs) auto
  have xG: "x \<in> G" and ysG: "set ys \<subseteq> G" using assms(1) xs by auto
  have Pg: "lprod ys \<in> G" by (rule lprod_mem[OF ysG])
  have hx: "x \<cdot> lprod ys = e" using assms(3) xs by simp
  have snoc: "lprod (ys @ [x]) = lprod ys \<cdot> x" using lprod_snoc[OF xG] ysG by blast
  have "lprod (rotate1 xs) = lprod (ys @ [x])" by (simp add: xs)
  also have "\<dots> = lprod ys \<cdot> x" by (rule snoc)
  also have "\<dots> = e" by (rule lprod_cancel[OF xG Pg hx])
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

section \<open>The counting set\<close>

definition T_set :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a list set" where
  "T_set n = {xs. set xs \<subseteq> G \<and> length xs = n}"

definition X_set :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a list set" where
  "X_set p = {xs \<in> T_set p. lprod xs = e}"

lemma finite_T:
  assumes "finite G"
  shows "finite (T_set n)"
  unfolding T_set_def by (rule finite_lists_length_eq[OF assms])

lemma card_T:
  assumes "finite G"
  shows "card (T_set n) = card G ^ n"
  unfolding T_set_def by (rule card_lists_length_eq[OF assms])

lemma X_eq:
  assumes fG: "finite G" and p1: "1 < p"
  shows "X_set p = (\<lambda>ys. ys @ [ginv (lprod ys)]) ` T_set (p - 1)"
proof (intro equalityI subsetI)
  fix xs assume "xs \<in> X_set p"
  then have xsT: "set xs \<subseteq> G" and len: "length xs = p" and ev: "lprod xs = e"
    unfolding X_set_def T_set_def by auto
  have ne: "xs \<noteq> []" using len p1 by auto
  have dec: "butlast xs @ [last xs] = xs" by (rule append_butlast_last_id[OF ne])
  have ysG: "set (butlast xs) \<subseteq> G" using xsT in_set_butlastD by blast
  have zG: "last xs \<in> G" using xsT last_in_set[OF ne] by blast
  have lenb: "length (butlast xs) = p - 1" using len by simp
  have Pg: "lprod (butlast xs) \<in> G" by (rule lprod_mem[OF ysG])
  have snoc: "lprod (butlast xs @ [last xs]) = lprod (butlast xs) \<cdot> last xs"
    using lprod_snoc[OF zG] ysG by blast
  have hPz: "lprod (butlast xs) \<cdot> last xs = e" by (metis snoc dec ev)
  have hz: "last xs = ginv (lprod (butlast xs))" by (rule unique_inv[OF Pg zG hPz])
  have eqx: "xs = (\<lambda>ys. ys @ [ginv (lprod ys)]) (butlast xs)"
    by (metis dec hz)
  have memT: "butlast xs \<in> T_set (p - 1)" unfolding T_set_def using ysG lenb by simp
  show "xs \<in> (\<lambda>ys. ys @ [ginv (lprod ys)]) ` T_set (p - 1)"
    by (rule image_eqI[OF eqx memT])
next
  fix xs assume "xs \<in> (\<lambda>ys. ys @ [ginv (lprod ys)]) ` T_set (p - 1)"
  then obtain ys where ysT: "ys \<in> T_set (p - 1)"
    and xs_eq: "xs = ys @ [ginv (lprod ys)]" by auto
  have ysG: "set ys \<subseteq> G" and lenys: "length ys = p - 1"
    using ysT unfolding T_set_def by auto
  have Pg: "lprod ys \<in> G" by (rule lprod_mem[OF ysG])
  have zG: "ginv (lprod ys) \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF Pg])
  have setx: "set xs \<subseteq> G" using xs_eq ysG zG by auto
  have p1': "p - 1 + 1 = p" using p1 by arith
  have lenx: "length xs = p" using xs_eq lenys p1' by simp
  have snoc: "lprod (ys @ [ginv (lprod ys)]) = lprod ys \<cdot> ginv (lprod ys)"
    using lprod_snoc[OF zG] ysG by blast
  have ev: "lprod xs = e" using snoc xs_eq rinv[OF Pg] by simp
  show "xs \<in> X_set p"
    unfolding X_set_def T_set_def using setx lenx ev by simp
qed

lemma card_X:
  assumes fG: "finite G" and p1: "1 < p"
  shows "card (X_set p) = card G ^ (p - 1)"
proof -
  have inj: "inj_on (\<lambda>ys. ys @ [ginv (lprod ys)]) (T_set (p - 1))"
  proof (rule inj_onI)
    fix ys zs
    assume "ys \<in> T_set (p - 1)" and "zs \<in> T_set (p - 1)"
      and eq: "ys @ [ginv (lprod ys)] = zs @ [ginv (lprod zs)]"
    have "butlast (ys @ [ginv (lprod ys)]) = butlast (zs @ [ginv (lprod zs)])" using eq by simp
    then show "ys = zs" by simp
  qed
  have "card (X_set p) = card ((\<lambda>ys. ys @ [ginv (lprod ys)]) ` T_set (p - 1))"
    by (simp only: X_eq[OF fG p1])
  also have "\<dots> = card (T_set (p - 1))" by (rule card_image[OF inj])
  also have "\<dots> = card G ^ (p - 1)" by (rule card_T[OF fG])
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

section \<open>Cauchy's theorem\<close>

theorem (in grp) cauchy:
  assumes "finite G" and "prime p" and "p dvd card G"
  shows "\<exists>x\<in>G. pow x p = e \<and> (\<forall>k. 0 < k \<longrightarrow> k < p \<longrightarrow> pow x k \<noteq> e)"
proof -
  note fG = assms(1)
  note pp = assms(2)
  note hdvd = assms(3)
  have p1: "1 < p" using pp by (simp add: prime_def)
  have pos: "0 < p - 1" using p1 by arith
  have h2: "card G dvd card G ^ (p - 1)" using pos by simp
  have cardX: "p dvd card (X_set p)"
  proof -
    have "p dvd card G ^ (p - 1)" by (rule dvd_trans[OF hdvd h2])
    then show ?thesis using card_X[OF fG p1] by simp
  qed
  have finX: "finite (X_set p)"
  proof -
    have sub: "X_set p \<subseteq> T_set p" unfolding X_set_def by auto
    show ?thesis by (rule finite_subset[OF sub finite_T[OF fG]])
  qed
  have rot_sub: "rotate1 ` X_set p \<subseteq> X_set p"
  proof
    fix z assume "z \<in> rotate1 ` X_set p"
    then obtain xs where xsX: "xs \<in> X_set p" and zr: "z = rotate1 xs" by blast
    then have xsT: "set xs \<subseteq> G" and len: "length xs = p" and ev: "lprod xs = e"
      unfolding X_set_def T_set_def by auto
    have ne: "xs \<noteq> []" using len p1 by auto
    have "lprod z = e" using zr rotate_lprod[OF xsT ne ev] by simp
    moreover have "set z \<subseteq> G" using zr xsT by simp
    moreover have "length z = p" using zr len by simp
    ultimately show "z \<in> X_set p" unfolding X_set_def T_set_def by simp
  qed
  have rot_pow: "\<forall>xs\<in>X_set p. (rotate1 ^^ p) xs = xs"
  proof
    fix xs assume xsX: "xs \<in> X_set p"
    then have len: "length xs = p" unfolding X_set_def T_set_def by auto
    have "(rotate1 ^^ p) xs = rotate p xs" by (simp add: rotate_def)
    also have "\<dots> = xs" using len by simp
    finally show "(rotate1 ^^ p) xs = xs" .
  qed
  have orb0 := orbit_mod[where f = rotate1, OF pp, rule_format]
  have orb: "card (X_set p) mod p = card {xs \<in> X_set p. rotate1 xs = xs} mod p"
    using orb0 le_refl finX rot_sub rot_pow by blast
  have cX0: "card (X_set p) mod p = 0" using cardX by (simp add: dvd_eq_mod_eq_0)
  have rF: "replicate p e \<in> {xs \<in> X_set p. rotate1 xs = xs}"
  proof -
    have "set (replicate p e) \<subseteq> G" using unit_closed by (simp add: subset_iff)
    moreover have "length (replicate p e) = p" by simp
    moreover have "lprod (replicate p e) = e" by (simp add: lprod_replicate pow_e)
    ultimately show ?thesis unfolding X_set_def T_set_def by simp
  qed
  have ex: "\<exists>xs \<in> {xs \<in> X_set p. rotate1 xs = xs}. xs \<noteq> replicate p e"
  proof (rule ccontr)
    assume "\<not> (\<exists>xs \<in> {xs \<in> X_set p. rotate1 xs = xs}. xs \<noteq> replicate p e)"
    then have "{xs \<in> X_set p. rotate1 xs = xs} = {replicate p e}" using rF by blast
    then have "card {xs \<in> X_set p. rotate1 xs = xs} = 1" by simp
    then have "card {xs \<in> X_set p. rotate1 xs = xs} mod p = 1"
      using p1 by (simp add: mod_less)
    with orb cX0 show False by simp
  qed
  then obtain xs where xsF: "xs \<in> X_set p" and rxs: "rotate1 xs = xs"
    and xsr: "xs \<noteq> replicate p e" by blast
  have xsT: "set xs \<subseteq> G" and len: "length xs = p" and ev: "lprod xs = e"
    using xsF unfolding X_set_def T_set_def by auto
  have ne: "xs \<noteq> []" using len p1 by auto
  have "xs = [] \<or> card (set xs) = 1" using rotate1_fixpoint_card[OF rxs] by blast
  then have card1: "card (set xs) = 1" using ne by blast
  obtain a where sa: "set xs = {a}" using card1 by (rule card_1_singletonE)
  have all_a: "replicate (length xs) a = xs"
    by (rule replicate_length_same) (simp add: sa)
  have aG: "a \<in> G" using xsT sa by auto
  have pa: "pow a p = e"
  proof -
    have "pow a p = lprod (replicate p a)" by (simp add: lprod_replicate)
    also have "\<dots> = e" using all_a len ev by simp
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  have ane: "a \<noteq> e"
  proof
    assume "a = e"
    then have "xs = replicate p e" using all_a len by simp
    with xsr show False by simp
  qed
  show ?thesis
  proof (intro bexI conjI allI impI)
    show "pow a p = e" by (rule pa)
  next
    fix k
    assume k0: "0 < k" and kp: "k < p" and ek: "pow a k = e"
    have per: "(mult a ^^ p) e = e" by (simp only: pow_iter pa)
    have mm: "(mult a ^^ k) e = e" by (simp only: pow_iter ek)
    have "mult a e = e" by (rule prime_orbit_fixed[OF pp per mm k0 kp])
    then have "a \<cdot> e = e" by simp
    then have "a = e" using aG runit by metis
    with ane show False by blast
  next
    show "a \<in> G" by (rule aG)
  qed
qed

end

text \<open>
  Proof outline (the classical counting argument).
  Let \<open>X\<close> be the set of lists of length \<open>p\<close> over \<open>G\<close> whose product is \<open>e\<close>.
  \<^item> \<open>|X| = |G|^(p-1)\<close>, so \<open>p\<close> divides \<open>|X|\<close>.
  \<^item> Cyclic rotation \<open>rotate1\<close> permutes \<open>X\<close> with \<open>rotate1^p = id\<close>.
  \<^item> Orbits of non-fixed points have size \<open>p\<close>, so \<open>|X| \<equiv> |Fix| (mod p)\<close>.
  \<^item> The fixed points are the constant lists \<open>replicate p a\<close>; since \<open>|Fix| \<equiv> 0 (mod p)\<close>
    and \<open>replicate p e\<close> is fixed, there is a fixed point \<open>replicate p a\<close> with \<open>a \<noteq> e\<close>.
    Then \<open>a^p = e\<close> and, since \<open>p\<close> is prime, \<open>a\<close> has order exactly \<open>p\<close>.
\<close>

section \<open>Iterates of a map\<close>

lemma iter_Suc_app: "(f ^^ Suc n) z = f ((f ^^ n) z)"
  by (simp only: funpow.simps comp_apply)

lemma iter_fixed:
  assumes "f y = y"
  shows "(f ^^ k) y = y"
proof (induction k)
  case 0
  show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc k)
  have "(f ^^ Suc k) y = f ((f ^^ k) y)" by (rule iter_Suc_app)
  also have "\<dots> = f y" using Suc.IH by simp
  also have "\<dots> = y" by (rule assms)
  finally show ?case .
qed

lemma iter_back:
  assumes "(f ^^ Suc q) y = y"
  shows "y = (f ^^ q) (f y)"
proof -
  have "y = (f ^^ Suc q) y" by (rule assms[symmetric])
  also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ q) (f y)" by (simp only: funpow_Suc_right comp_apply)
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma gcd_closure:
  fixes Q :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> bool" and a b :: nat
  assumes base: "\<And>m. Q m 0"
    and step: "\<And>m n. 0 < n \<Longrightarrow> Q n (m mod n) \<Longrightarrow> Q m n"
  shows "Q a b"
  by (rule gcd_nat_induct[where P = Q and m = a and n = b, OF base step])

section \<open>A fixed point of a prime-length cycle is the identity\<close>

lemma prime_orbit_fixed:
  fixes f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a" and x :: 'a and p m :: nat
  assumes pp: "prime p" and per: "(f ^^ p) x = x" and mm: "(f ^^ m) x = x"
    and m0: "0 < m" and mp: "m < p"
  shows "f x = x"
proof -
  have add_in: "\<And>a b. (f ^^ a) x = x \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ b) x = x \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ (a + b)) x = x"
  proof -
    fix a b :: nat
    assume ha: "(f ^^ a) x = x" and hb: "(f ^^ b) x = x"
    have "(f ^^ (a + b)) x = (f ^^ a) ((f ^^ b) x)" by (simp only: funpow_add comp_apply)
    also have "\<dots> = x" by (simp only: hb ha)
    finally show "(f ^^ (a + b)) x = x" .
  qed
  have sub_in: "\<And>a b. (f ^^ a) x = x \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ (a + b)) x = x \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ b) x = x"
  proof -
    fix a b :: nat
    assume ha: "(f ^^ a) x = x" and hab: "(f ^^ (a + b)) x = x"
    have "(f ^^ b) x = (f ^^ b) ((f ^^ a) x)" by (simp only: ha)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (b + a)) x" by (simp only: funpow_add comp_apply)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (a + b)) x" by (simp only: add.commute)
    also have "\<dots> = x" by (rule hab)
    finally show "(f ^^ b) x = x" .
  qed
  have mul_in: "\<And>a k. (f ^^ a) x = x \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ (k * a)) x = x"
  proof -
    fix a k :: nat
    assume ha: "(f ^^ a) x = x"
    show "(f ^^ (k * a)) x = x"
    proof (induction k)
      case 0
      show ?case by simp
    next
      case (Suc k)
      have "(f ^^ (Suc k * a)) x = (f ^^ (a + k * a)) x" by (simp only: mult_Suc)
      also have "\<dots> = x" by (rule add_in[OF ha Suc.IH])
      finally show ?case .
    qed
  qed
  have base_c: "\<And>m. (f ^^ m) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ 0) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ gcd m 0) x = x"
    by simp
  have step_c: "\<And>m n. 0 < n \<Longrightarrow>
      ((f ^^ n) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ (m mod n)) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ gcd n (m mod n)) x = x) \<Longrightarrow>
      ((f ^^ m) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ n) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ gcd m n) x = x)"
  proof -
    fix m n :: nat
    assume n0: "0 < n"
      and IH: "(f ^^ n) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ (m mod n)) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ gcd n (m mod n)) x = x"
    show "(f ^^ m) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ n) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ gcd m n) x = x"
    proof (intro impI)
      assume hm: "(f ^^ m) x = x" and hn: "(f ^^ n) x = x"
      have h1: "(f ^^ (m div n * n)) x = x" by (rule mul_in[OF hn])
      have h2: "(f ^^ (m div n * n + m mod n)) x = x" by (simp only: div_mult_mod_eq hm)
      have hmod: "(f ^^ (m mod n)) x = x" by (rule sub_in[OF h1 h2])
      have nz: "n \<noteq> 0" using n0 by simp
      have eqg: "gcd m n = gcd n (m mod n)" by (rule gcd_non_0_nat[OF nz])
      have "(f ^^ gcd n (m mod n)) x = x" using IH hn hmod by blast
      then show "(f ^^ gcd m n) x = x" by (simp only: eqg this)
    qed
  qed
  have gS: "(f ^^ gcd m p) x = x"
  proof -
    have "(f ^^ m) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ p) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ gcd m p) x = x"
      by (rule gcd_closure[where Q = "\<lambda>a b. (f ^^ a) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ b) x = x \<longrightarrow> (f ^^ gcd a b) x = x"
            and a = m and b = p, OF base_c step_c])
    then show ?thesis using mm per by blast
  qed
  have gd: "gcd m p dvd p" by (rule gcd_dvd2)
  have pdiv: "\<forall>d. d dvd p \<longrightarrow> d = 1 \<or> d = p" using pp by (simp add: prime_def)
  have gcd_cases: "gcd m p = 1 \<or> gcd m p = p" using pdiv gd by blast
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "gcd m p = 1")
    case True
    have "(f ^^ 1) x = x" using gS True by (metis)
    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case False
    then have gp: "gcd m p = p" using gcd_cases by blast
    have "p dvd m" using gcd_dvd1[of m p] gp by simp
    then have "p \<le> m" using m0 dvd_imp_le by blast
    then have False using mp by linarith
    then show ?thesis by blast
  qed
qed

section \<open>Orbit counting modulo a prime\<close>

lemma orbit_mod:
  fixes f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a" and p :: nat
  assumes pp: "prime p"
  shows "\<forall>n X. card X \<le> n \<longrightarrow> finite X \<longrightarrow> f ` X \<subseteq> X \<longrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x\<in>X. (f ^^ p) x = x) \<longrightarrow> card X mod p = card {x\<in>X. f x = x} mod p"
proof -
  have p2: "1 < p" using pp by (simp add: prime_def)
  obtain q where pq: "p = Suc q" using p2 by (cases p) auto
  show ?thesis
  proof (intro allI)
    fix n
    show "\<forall>X. card X \<le> n \<longrightarrow> finite X \<longrightarrow> f ` X \<subseteq> X \<longrightarrow>
        (\<forall>x\<in>X. (f ^^ p) x = x) \<longrightarrow> card X mod p = card {x\<in>X. f x = x} mod p"
    proof (induction n)
      case 0
      show ?case
      proof (intro allI impI)
        fix X
        assume cX: "card X \<le> 0" and fin: "finite X"
        then have "X = {}" by auto
        then show "card X mod p = card {x\<in>X. f x = x} mod p" by simp
      qed
    next
      case (Suc n)
      have ih: "\<forall>X. card X \<le> n \<longrightarrow> finite X \<longrightarrow> f ` X \<subseteq> X \<longrightarrow>
          (\<forall>x\<in>X. (f ^^ p) x = x) \<longrightarrow> card X mod p = card {x\<in>X. f x = x} mod p"
        using Suc.IH by blast
      show ?case
      proof (intro allI impI)
        fix X
        assume cX: "card X \<le> Suc n" and fin: "finite X" and sub: "f ` X \<subseteq> X"
          and per: "\<forall>x\<in>X. (f ^^ p) x = x"
        show "card X mod p = card {x\<in>X. f x = x} mod p"
        proof (cases "\<forall>x\<in>X. f x = x")
          case True
          then have "{x\<in>X. f x = x} = X" by blast
          then show ?thesis by simp
        next
          case False
          then obtain x where xX: "x \<in> X" and nfix: "f x \<noteq> x" by blast
          define O where "O = (\<lambda>i. (f ^^ i) x) ` {..<p}"
          have finO: "finite O" unfolding O_def by simp
          have px: "(f ^^ p) x = x" using per xX by blast
          have orb_in: "\<And>i. (f ^^ i) x \<in> X"
          proof -
            fix i
            show "(f ^^ i) x \<in> X"
            proof (induction i)
              case 0
              show ?case using xX by simp
            next
              case (Suc i)
              have "(f ^^ Suc i) x = f ((f ^^ i) x)" by (rule iter_Suc_app)
              then show ?case using Suc.IH sub by blast
            qed
          qed
          have no_fix: "\<And>i. i < p \<Longrightarrow> f ((f ^^ i) x) \<noteq> (f ^^ i) x"
          proof -
            fix i assume ip: "i < p"
            show "f ((f ^^ i) x) \<noteq> (f ^^ i) x"
            proof
              assume eq: "f ((f ^^ i) x) = (f ^^ i) x"
              have pe: "p - i + i = p" using ip by arith
              have hy: "(f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ i) x) = (f ^^ i) x" by (rule iter_fixed[OF eq])
              have s1: "(f ^^ p) x = (f ^^ ((p - i) + i)) x" by (simp only: pe)
              have s2: "(f ^^ ((p - i) + i)) x = (f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ i) x)"
                by (simp only: funpow_add comp_apply)
              have xi: "x = (f ^^ i) x" by (metis px s1 s2 hy)
              have "f x = f ((f ^^ i) x)" using xi by (rule arg_cong)
              also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ i) x" by (rule eq)
              also have "\<dots> = x" using xi by (rule sym)
              finally have "f x = x" .
              with nfix show False by blast
            qed
          qed
          have lt_ne: "\<And>i j. i < j \<Longrightarrow> j < p \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ i) x \<noteq> (f ^^ j) x"
          proof -
            fix i j :: nat
            assume ij: "i < j" and jp: "j < p"
            show "(f ^^ i) x \<noteq> (f ^^ j) x"
            proof
              assume eq: "(f ^^ i) x = (f ^^ j) x"
              have pj: "p - j + j = p" using jp by arith
              have B: "(f ^^ (p - j)) ((f ^^ j) x) = x"
              proof -
                have "(f ^^ (p - j)) ((f ^^ j) x) = (f ^^ ((p - j) + j)) x"
                  by (simp only: funpow_add comp_apply)
                also have "\<dots> = x" by (simp only: pj px)
                finally show ?thesis .
              qed
              have C: "(f ^^ (p - j)) ((f ^^ i) x) = (f ^^ (p - j + i)) x"
                by (simp only: funpow_add comp_apply)
              have D1: "(f ^^ (p - j)) ((f ^^ i) x) = (f ^^ (p - j)) ((f ^^ j) x)"
                by (simp only: eq)
              have D: "(f ^^ (p - j + i)) x = x" by (simp only: C[symmetric] D1 B)
              have m0: "0 < p - j + i" using jp by arith
              have mp: "p - j + i < p" using ij by arith
              have "f x = x" by (rule prime_orbit_fixed[OF pp px D m0 mp])
              with nfix show False by blast
            qed
          qed
          have inj_O: "inj_on (\<lambda>i. (f ^^ i) x) {..<p}"
          proof (rule inj_onI)
            fix i j assume hi: "i \<in> {..<p}" and hj: "j \<in> {..<p}"
              and eq: "(f ^^ i) x = (f ^^ j) x"
            have ip: "i < p" using hi by simp
            have jp: "j < p" using hj by simp
            show "i = j"
            proof (rule linorder_cases[of i j])
              assume "i < j"
              then have "(f ^^ i) x \<noteq> (f ^^ j) x" using lt_ne jp by blast
              with eq show ?thesis by contradiction
            next
              assume "i = j"
              then show ?thesis .
            next
              assume "j < i"
              then have "(f ^^ j) x \<noteq> (f ^^ i) x" using lt_ne ip by blast
              with eq show ?thesis by metis
            qed
          qed
          have cardO: "card O = p" unfolding O_def by (simp add: card_image inj_O)
          have O_sub: "O \<subseteq> X" unfolding O_def using orb_in by blast
          have fin_diff: "finite (X - O)" using fin by blast
          have eqU: "(X - O) \<union> O = X" using O_sub by blast
          have split: "card X = card (X - O) + p"
          proof -
            have "card X = card ((X - O) \<union> O)" using eqU by simp
            also have "\<dots> = card (X - O) + card O"
              by (rule card_Un_disjoint[OF fin_diff finO]) blast
            also have "\<dots> = card (X - O) + p" using cardO by simp
            finally show ?thesis .
          qed
          have not_fix_O: "\<And>y. y \<in> O \<Longrightarrow> f y \<noteq> y"
          proof -
            fix y assume "y \<in> O"
            then obtain i where ip: "i < p" and yi: "y = (f ^^ i) x"
              unfolding O_def by auto
            show "f y \<noteq> y" by (metis no_fix[OF ip] yi)
          qed
          have fix_eq: "{y \<in> X - O. f y = y} = {y \<in> X. f y = y}"
            using not_fix_O by blast
          have sub': "f ` (X - O) \<subseteq> X - O"
          proof
            fix z assume "z \<in> f ` (X - O)"
            then obtain y where yX: "y \<in> X" and yO: "y \<notin> O" and zfy: "z = f y"
              by auto
            have fyX: "z \<in> X" using sub yX zfy by blast
            have zO: "z \<notin> O"
            proof
              assume zO: "z \<in> O"
              then obtain i where ip: "i < p" and zi: "z = (f ^^ i) x"
                unfolding O_def by auto
              have yper: "(f ^^ p) y = y" using per yX by blast
              have yper': "(f ^^ Suc q) y = y" using yper pq by (simp only: pq[symmetric])
              have yback: "y = (f ^^ q) (f y)" by (rule iter_back[OF yper'])
              have fy: "f y = (f ^^ i) x" by (metis zfy zi)
              have yO': "y \<in> O"
              proof (cases i)
                case 0
                have "y = (f ^^ q) (f y)" by (rule yback)
                also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ q) x" using fy 0 by simp
                finally have yq: "y = (f ^^ q) x" .
                have qp: "q < p" using pq by arith
                have qmem: "q \<in> {..<p}" using qp by simp
                have hyq: "y = (\<lambda>i. (f ^^ i) x) q" using yq by simp
                show ?thesis unfolding O_def by (rule image_eqI[OF hyq qmem])
              next
                case (Suc i')
                have fy2: "f y = f ((f ^^ i') x)" using fy Suc by (simp only: Suc iter_Suc_app)
                have w: "(f ^^ Suc q) ((f ^^ i') x) = (f ^^ q) (f ((f ^^ i') x))"
                  by (simp only: funpow_Suc_right comp_apply)
                have i'p: "i' < p" using Suc ip by arith
                have mem': "(f ^^ i') x \<in> X" by (rule orb_in)
                have per_i': "(f ^^ p) ((f ^^ i') x) = (f ^^ i') x" using per mem' by blast
                have "y = (f ^^ q) (f y)" by (rule yback)
                also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ q) (f ((f ^^ i') x))" using fy2 by simp
                also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ Suc q) ((f ^^ i') x)" by (simp only: w)
                also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ p) ((f ^^ i') x)" by (simp only: pq[symmetric])
                also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ i') x" by (rule per_i')
                finally have yi': "y = (f ^^ i') x" .
                have qm: "i' \<in> {..<p}" using i'p by simp
                have hyi: "y = (\<lambda>i. (f ^^ i) x) i'" using yi' by simp
                show ?thesis unfolding O_def by (rule image_eqI[OF hyi qm])
              qed
              show False using yO yO' by blast
            qed
            show "z \<in> X - O" using fyX zO by blast
          qed
          have per': "\<forall>x\<in>X - O. (f ^^ p) x = x" using per by blast
          have le_n: "card (X - O) \<le> n" using split cX p2 by linarith
          have ih_app: "card (X - O) mod p = card {y \<in> X - O. f y = y} mod p"
            using ih le_n fin_diff sub' per' by blast
          have "card X mod p = card (X - O) mod p" using split by simp
          also have "\<dots> = card {y \<in> X - O. f y = y} mod p" by (rule ih_app)
          also have "\<dots> = card {y \<in> X. f y = y} mod p" by (simp only: fix_eq)
          finally show ?thesis .
        qed
      qed
    qed
  qed
qed

section \<open>Group facts derived from the basic axioms\<close>

context grp
begin

lemma idem_unit:
  assumes uG: "u \<in> G" and uu: "u \<cdot> u = u"
  shows "u = e"
proof -
  have h1: "ginv u \<cdot> u = e" by (rule left_inv[OF uG])
  have h2: "(ginv u \<cdot> u) \<cdot> u = ginv u \<cdot> (u \<cdot> u)"
    by (rule assoc[OF inv_closed[OF uG] uG uG])
  have "u = e \<cdot> u" by (rule left_unit[OF uG, symmetric])
  also have "\<dots> = (ginv u \<cdot> u) \<cdot> u" by (simp only: h1)
  also have "\<dots> = ginv u \<cdot> (u \<cdot> u)" by (rule h2)
  also have "\<dots> = ginv u \<cdot> u" by (simp only: uu)
  also have "\<dots> = e" by (rule h1)
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma rinv:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G"
  shows "x \<cdot> ginv x = e"
proof -
  have yG: "ginv x \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF xG])
  have yx: "ginv x \<cdot> x = e" by (rule left_inv[OF xG])
  have xyG: "x \<cdot> ginv x \<in> G" by (rule closed[OF xG yG])
  have step1: "ginv x \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x) = ginv x"
  proof -
    have "ginv x \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x) = (ginv x \<cdot> x) \<cdot> ginv x"
      by (rule assoc[OF yG xG yG, symmetric])
    also have "\<dots> = e \<cdot> ginv x" by (simp only: yx)
    also have "\<dots> = ginv x" by (rule left_unit[OF yG])
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  have idem: "(x \<cdot> ginv x) \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x) = x \<cdot> ginv x"
  proof -
    have "(x \<cdot> ginv x) \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x) = x \<cdot> (ginv x \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x))"
      by (rule assoc[OF xG yG xyG])
    also have "\<dots> = x \<cdot> ginv x" by (simp only: step1)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  show ?thesis by (rule idem_unit[OF xyG idem])
qed

lemma runit:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G"
  shows "x \<cdot> e = x"
proof -
  have yG: "ginv x \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF xG])
  have "x \<cdot> e = x \<cdot> (ginv x \<cdot> x)" by (simp only: left_inv[OF xG])
  also have "\<dots> = (x \<cdot> ginv x) \<cdot> x" by (rule assoc[OF xG yG xG, symmetric])
  also have "\<dots> = e \<cdot> x" by (simp only: rinv[OF xG])
  also have "\<dots> = x" by (rule left_unit[OF xG])
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma unique_inv:
  assumes PG: "P \<in> G" and zG: "z \<in> G" and hPz: "P \<cdot> z = e"
  shows "z = ginv P"
proof -
  have "z = e \<cdot> z" by (rule left_unit[OF zG, symmetric])
  also have "\<dots> = (ginv P \<cdot> P) \<cdot> z" by (simp only: left_inv[OF PG])
  also have "\<dots> = ginv P \<cdot> (P \<cdot> z)" by (rule assoc[OF inv_closed[OF PG] PG zG])
  also have "\<dots> = ginv P \<cdot> e" by (simp only: hPz)
  also have "\<dots> = ginv P" by (rule runit[OF inv_closed[OF PG]])
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma pow_Suc_mul: "pow x (Suc n) = x \<cdot> pow x n"
  by simp

lemma pow_e: "pow e n = e"
  by (induction n) (simp_all add: left_unit unit_closed)

lemma pow_iter: "(mult a ^^ n) e = pow a n"
  by (induction n) simp_all

section \<open>Products of lists\<close>

definition lprod :: "'a list \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "lprod xs = foldr mult xs e"

lemma lprod_Nil [simp]: "lprod [] = e"
  by (simp add: lprod_def)

lemma lprod_Cons [simp]: "lprod (y # ys) = y \<cdot> lprod ys"
  by (simp add: lprod_def)

lemma lprod_mem:
  assumes "set xs \<subseteq> G"
  shows "lprod xs \<in> G"
  using assms
proof (induction xs)
  case Nil
  show ?case by (simp add: unit_closed)
next
  case (Cons y ys)
  have yG: "y \<in> G" using Cons.prems by auto
  have ysG: "set ys \<subseteq> G" using Cons.prems by auto
  have ihG: "lprod ys \<in> G" using Cons.IH ysG by blast
  have "y \<cdot> lprod ys \<in> G" by (rule closed[OF yG ihG])
  then show ?case by simp
qed

lemma lprod_snoc:
  assumes zG: "z \<in> G"
  shows "\<forall>ys. set ys \<subseteq> G \<longrightarrow> lprod (ys @ [z]) = lprod ys \<cdot> z"
proof (rule allI)
  fix ys
  show "set ys \<subseteq> G \<longrightarrow> lprod (ys @ [z]) = lprod ys \<cdot> z"
  proof (induction ys)
    case Nil
    show ?case by (simp add: zG runit left_unit)
  next
    case (Cons y ys)
    show ?case
    proof (rule impI)
      assume sub: "set (y # ys) \<subseteq> G"
      have yG: "y \<in> G" using sub by auto
      have ysG: "set ys \<subseteq> G" using sub by auto
      have Pg: "lprod ys \<in> G" by (rule lprod_mem[OF ysG])
      have ih: "lprod (ys @ [z]) = lprod ys \<cdot> z" using Cons.IH ysG by blast
      have "lprod ((y # ys) @ [z]) = y \<cdot> lprod (ys @ [z])" by simp
      also have "\<dots> = y \<cdot> (lprod ys \<cdot> z)" using ih by simp
      also have "\<dots> = (y \<cdot> lprod ys) \<cdot> z" by (rule assoc[OF yG Pg zG, symmetric])
      also have "\<dots> = lprod (y # ys) \<cdot> z" by simp
      finally show "lprod ((y # ys) @ [z]) = lprod (y # ys) \<cdot> z" .
    qed
  qed
qed

lemma lprod_cancel:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G" and PG: "lprod ys \<in> G" and hx: "x \<cdot> lprod ys = e"
  shows "lprod ys \<cdot> x = e"
proof -
  have "lprod ys = ginv x"
  proof -
    have "lprod ys = e \<cdot> lprod ys" by (rule left_unit[OF PG, symmetric])
    also have "\<dots> = (ginv x \<cdot> x) \<cdot> lprod ys" by (simp only: left_inv[OF xG])
    also have "\<dots> = ginv x \<cdot> (x \<cdot> lprod ys)" by (rule assoc[OF inv_closed[OF xG] xG PG])
    also have "\<dots> = ginv x \<cdot> e" by (simp only: hx)
    also have "\<dots> = ginv x" by (rule runit[OF inv_closed[OF xG]])
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  then show ?thesis by (simp only: this left_inv[OF xG])
qed

lemma lprod_replicate: "lprod (replicate n a) = pow a n"
  by (induction n) simp_all

section \<open>Rotation of lists\<close>

lemma rotate_lprod:
  assumes "set xs \<subseteq> G" and "xs \<noteq> []" and "lprod xs = e"
  shows "lprod (rotate1 xs) = e"
proof -
  obtain x ys where xs: "xs = x # ys" using assms(2) by (cases xs) auto
  have xG: "x \<in> G" and ysG: "set ys \<subseteq> G" using assms(1) xs by auto
  have Pg: "lprod ys \<in> G" by (rule lprod_mem[OF ysG])
  have hx: "x \<cdot> lprod ys = e" using assms(3) xs by simp
  have snoc: "lprod (ys @ [x]) = lprod ys \<cdot> x" using lprod_snoc[OF xG] ysG by blast
  have "lprod (rotate1 xs) = lprod (ys @ [x])" by (simp add: xs)
  also have "\<dots> = lprod ys \<cdot> x" by (rule snoc)
  also have "\<dots> = e" by (rule lprod_cancel[OF xG Pg hx])
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

section \<open>The counting set\<close>

definition T_set :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a list set" where
  "T_set n = {xs. set xs \<subseteq> G \<and> length xs = n}"

definition X_set :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a list set" where
  "X_set p = {xs \<in> T_set p. lprod xs = e}"

lemma finite_T:
  assumes "finite G"
  shows "finite (T_set n)"
  unfolding T_set_def by (rule finite_lists_length_eq[OF assms])

lemma card_T:
  assumes "finite G"
  shows "card (T_set n) = card G ^ n"
  unfolding T_set_def by (rule card_lists_length_eq[OF assms])

lemma X_eq:
  assumes fG: "finite G" and p1: "1 < p"
  shows "X_set p = (\<lambda>ys. ys @ [ginv (lprod ys)]) ` T_set (p - 1)"
proof (intro equalityI subsetI)
  fix xs assume "xs \<in> X_set p"
  then have xsT: "set xs \<subseteq> G" and len: "length xs = p" and ev: "lprod xs = e"
    unfolding X_set_def T_set_def by auto
  have ne: "xs \<noteq> []" using len p1 by auto
  have dec: "butlast xs @ [last xs] = xs" by (rule append_butlast_last_id[OF ne])
  have ysG: "set (butlast xs) \<subseteq> G" using xsT in_set_butlastD by blast
  have zG: "last xs \<in> G" using xsT last_in_set[OF ne] by blast
  have lenb: "length (butlast xs) = p - 1" using len by simp
  have Pg: "lprod (butlast xs) \<in> G" by (rule lprod_mem[OF ysG])
  have snoc: "lprod (butlast xs @ [last xs]) = lprod (butlast xs) \<cdot> last xs"
    using lprod_snoc[OF zG] ysG by blast
  have hPz: "lprod (butlast xs) \<cdot> last xs = e" by (metis snoc dec ev)
  have hz: "last xs = ginv (lprod (butlast xs))" by (rule unique_inv[OF Pg zG hPz])
  have eqx: "xs = (\<lambda>ys. ys @ [ginv (lprod ys)]) (butlast xs)"
    by (metis dec hz)
  have memT: "butlast xs \<in> T_set (p - 1)" unfolding T_set_def using ysG lenb by simp
  show "xs \<in> (\<lambda>ys. ys @ [ginv (lprod ys)]) ` T_set (p - 1)"
    by (rule image_eqI[OF eqx memT])
next
  fix xs assume "xs \<in> (\<lambda>ys. ys @ [ginv (lprod ys)]) ` T_set (p - 1)"
  then obtain ys where ysT: "ys \<in> T_set (p - 1)"
    and xs_eq: "xs = ys @ [ginv (lprod ys)]" by auto
  have ysG: "set ys \<subseteq> G" and lenys: "length ys = p - 1"
    using ysT unfolding T_set_def by auto
  have Pg: "lprod ys \<in> G" by (rule lprod_mem[OF ysG])
  have zG: "ginv (lprod ys) \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF Pg])
  have setx: "set xs \<subseteq> G" using xs_eq ysG zG by auto
  have p1': "p - 1 + 1 = p" using p1 by arith
  have lenx: "length xs = p" using xs_eq lenys p1' by simp
  have snoc: "lprod (ys @ [ginv (lprod ys)]) = lprod ys \<cdot> ginv (lprod ys)"
    using lprod_snoc[OF zG] ysG by blast
  have ev: "lprod xs = e" using snoc xs_eq rinv[OF Pg] by simp
  show "xs \<in> X_set p"
    unfolding X_set_def T_set_def using setx lenx ev by simp
qed

lemma card_X:
  assumes fG: "finite G" and p1: "1 < p"
  shows "card (X_set p) = card G ^ (p - 1)"
proof -
  have inj: "inj_on (\<lambda>ys. ys @ [ginv (lprod ys)]) (T_set (p - 1))"
  proof (rule inj_onI)
    fix ys zs
    assume "ys \<in> T_set (p - 1)" and "zs \<in> T_set (p - 1)"
      and eq: "ys @ [ginv (lprod ys)] = zs @ [ginv (lprod zs)]"
    have "butlast (ys @ [ginv (lprod ys)]) = butlast (zs @ [ginv (lprod zs)])" using eq by simp
    then show "ys = zs" by simp
  qed
  have "card (X_set p) = card ((\<lambda>ys. ys @ [ginv (lprod ys)]) ` T_set (p - 1))"
    by (simp only: X_eq[OF fG p1])
  also have "\<dots> = card (T_set (p - 1))" by (rule card_image[OF inj])
  also have "\<dots> = card G ^ (p - 1)" by (rule card_T[OF fG])
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

end

section \<open>Cauchy's theorem\<close>

theorem (in grp) cauchy:
  assumes "finite G" and "prime p" and "p dvd card G"
  shows "\<exists>x\<in>G. pow x p = e \<and> (\<forall>k. 0 < k \<longrightarrow> k < p \<longrightarrow> pow x k \<noteq> e)"
proof -
  note fG = assms(1)
  note pp = assms(2)
  note hdvd = assms(3)
  have p1: "1 < p" using pp by (simp add: prime_def)
  have pos: "0 < p - 1" using p1 by arith
  have h2: "card G dvd card G ^ (p - 1)" using pos by simp
  have cardX: "p dvd card (X_set p)"
  proof -
    have "p dvd card G ^ (p - 1)" by (rule dvd_trans[OF hdvd h2])
    then show ?thesis using card_X[OF fG p1] by simp
  qed
  have finX: "finite (X_set p)"
  proof -
    have sub: "X_set p \<subseteq> T_set p" unfolding X_set_def by auto
    show ?thesis by (rule finite_subset[OF sub finite_T[OF fG]])
  qed
  have rot_sub: "rotate1 ` X_set p \<subseteq> X_set p"
  proof
    fix z assume "z \<in> rotate1 ` X_set p"
    then obtain xs where xsX: "xs \<in> X_set p" and zr: "z = rotate1 xs" by blast
    then have xsT: "set xs \<subseteq> G" and len: "length xs = p" and ev: "lprod xs = e"
      unfolding X_set_def T_set_def by auto
    have ne: "xs \<noteq> []" using len p1 by auto
    have "lprod z = e" using zr rotate_lprod[OF xsT ne ev] by simp
    moreover have "set z \<subseteq> G" using zr xsT by simp
    moreover have "length z = p" using zr len by simp
    ultimately show "z \<in> X_set p" unfolding X_set_def T_set_def by simp
  qed
  have rot_pow: "\<forall>xs\<in>X_set p. (rotate1 ^^ p) xs = xs"
  proof
    fix xs assume xsX: "xs \<in> X_set p"
    then have len: "length xs = p" unfolding X_set_def T_set_def by auto
    have "(rotate1 ^^ p) xs = rotate p xs" by (simp add: rotate_def)
    also have "\<dots> = xs" using len by simp
    finally show "(rotate1 ^^ p) xs = xs" .
  qed
  have orb0 := orbit_mod[where f = rotate1, OF pp, rule_format]
  have orb: "card (X_set p) mod p = card {xs \<in> X_set p. rotate1 xs = xs} mod p"
    using orb0 le_refl finX rot_sub rot_pow by blast
  have cX0: "card (X_set p) mod p = 0" using cardX by (simp add: dvd_eq_mod_eq_0)
  have rF: "replicate p e \<in> {xs \<in> X_set p. rotate1 xs = xs}"
  proof -
    have "set (replicate p e) \<subseteq> G" using unit_closed by (simp add: subset_iff)
    moreover have "length (replicate p e) = p" by simp
    moreover have "lprod (replicate p e) = e" by (simp add: lprod_replicate pow_e)
    ultimately show ?thesis unfolding X_set_def T_set_def by simp
  qed
  have ex: "\<exists>xs \<in> {xs \<in> X_set p. rotate1 xs = xs}. xs \<noteq> replicate p e"
  proof (rule ccontr)
    assume "\<not> (\<exists>xs \<in> {xs \<in> X_set p. rotate1 xs = xs}. xs \<noteq> replicate p e)"
    then have "{xs \<in> X_set p. rotate1 xs = xs} = {replicate p e}" using rF by blast
    then have "card {xs \<in> X_set p. rotate1 xs = xs} = 1" by simp
    then have "card {xs \<in> X_set p. rotate1 xs = xs} mod p = 1"
      using p1 by (simp add: mod_less)
    with orb cX0 show False by simp
  qed
  then obtain xs where xsF: "xs \<in> X_set p" and rxs: "rotate1 xs = xs"
    and xsr: "xs \<noteq> replicate p e" by blast
  have xsT: "set xs \<subseteq> G" and len: "length xs = p" and ev: "lprod xs = e"
    using xsF unfolding X_set_def T_set_def by auto
  have ne: "xs \<noteq> []" using len p1 by auto
  have "xs = [] \<or> card (set xs) = 1" using rotate1_fixpoint_card[OF rxs] by blast
  then have card1: "card (set xs) = 1" using ne by blast
  obtain a where sa: "set xs = {a}" using card1 by (rule card_1_singletonE)
  have all_a: "replicate (length xs) a = xs"
    by (rule replicate_length_same) (simp add: sa)
  have aG: "a \<in> G" using xsT sa by auto
  have pa: "pow a p = e"
  proof -
    have "pow a p = lprod (replicate p a)" by (simp add: lprod_replicate)
    also have "\<dots> = e" using all_a len ev by simp
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  have ane: "a \<noteq> e"
  proof
    assume "a = e"
    then have "xs = replicate p e" using all_a len by simp
    with xsr show False by simp
  qed
  show ?thesis
  proof (intro bexI conjI allI impI)
    show "pow a p = e" by (rule pa)
  next
    fix k
    assume k0: "0 < k" and kp: "k < p" and ek: "pow a k = e"
    have per: "(mult a ^^ p) e = e" by (simp only: pow_iter pa)
    have mm: "(mult a ^^ k) e = e" by (simp only: pow_iter ek)
    have "mult a e = e" by (rule prime_orbit_fixed[OF pp per mm k0 kp])
    then have "a \<cdot> e = e" by simp
    then have "a = e" using aG runit by metis
    with ane show False by blast
  next
    show "a \<in> G" by (rule aG)
  qed
qed

end

steps.message: The `blast`/`auto`/`metis` calls in nested blocks are the problem. I'm rewriting `orbit_mod` with explicit proofs (`bspec`, `imageE`, `bexE`, `card_mono`, `card_Diff_subset`, `DiffD1/2`) and no automated search, then re-testing part A.

arguments.command:
cat > /tmp/orbit_new.thy <<'EOF'
section \<open>Orbit counting modulo a prime\<close>

lemma orbit_mod:
  fixes f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a" and p :: nat
  assumes pp: "prime p"
  shows "\<forall>n X. card X \<le> n \<longrightarrow> finite X \<longrightarrow> f ` X \<subseteq> X \<longrightarrow>
    (\<forall>x\<in>X. (f ^^ p) x = x) \<longrightarrow> card X mod p = card {x\<in>X. f x = x} mod p"
proof -
  have p2: "1 < p" using pp by (simp add: prime_def)
  obtain q where pq: "p = Suc q" using p2 by (cases p) auto
  show ?thesis
  proof (intro allI)
    fix n
    show "\<forall>X. card X \<le> n \<longrightarrow> finite X \<longrightarrow> f ` X \<subseteq> X \<longrightarrow>
        (\<forall>x\<in>X. (f ^^ p) x = x) \<longrightarrow> card X mod p = card {x\<in>X. f x = x} mod p"
    proof (induction n)
      case 0
      show ?case
      proof (intro allI impI)
        fix X :: "'a set"
        assume cX: "card X \<le> 0" and fin: "finite X"
        have c0: "card X = 0" using cX by simp
        have "X = {}" using c0 fin by simp
        then show "card X mod p = card {x\<in>X. f x = x} mod p" by simp
      qed
    next
      case (Suc n)
      have ih: "\<forall>X. card X \<le> n \<longrightarrow> finite X \<longrightarrow> f ` X \<subseteq> X \<longrightarrow>
          (\<forall>x\<in>X. (f ^^ p) x = x) \<longrightarrow> card X mod p = card {x\<in>X. f x = x} mod p"
        by (rule Suc.IH)
      show ?case
      proof (intro allI impI)
        fix X :: "'a set"
        assume cX: "card X \<le> Suc n" and fin: "finite X" and sub: "f ` X \<subseteq> X"
          and per: "\<forall>x\<in>X. (f ^^ p) x = x"
        show "card X mod p = card {x\<in>X. f x = x} mod p"
        proof (cases "\<forall>x\<in>X. f x = x")
          case True
          have "{x\<in>X. f x = x} = X" using True by simp
          then show ?thesis by simp
        next
          case False
          have ex: "\<exists>x\<in>X. f x \<noteq> x" using False by (simp add: Ball_def Bex_def)
          obtain x where xX: "x \<in> X" and nfix: "f x \<noteq> x" by (rule bexE[OF ex])
          define Orb where "Orb = (\<lambda>i. (f ^^ i) x) ` {..<p}"
          have finO: "finite Orb" unfolding Orb_def by simp
          have px: "(f ^^ p) x = x" by (rule bspec[OF per xX])
          have orb_in: "\<And>i. (f ^^ i) x \<in> X"
          proof -
            fix i
            show "(f ^^ i) x \<in> X"
            proof (induction i)
              case 0
              show ?case using xX by simp
            next
              case (Suc i)
              have step: "f ((f ^^ i) x) \<in> X" by (rule subsetD[OF sub imageI[OF Suc.IH]])
              show ?case by (simp only: iter_Suc_app step)
            qed
          qed
          have no_fix: "\<And>i. i < p \<Longrightarrow> f ((f ^^ i) x) \<noteq> (f ^^ i) x"
          proof -
            fix i assume ip: "i < p"
            show "f ((f ^^ i) x) \<noteq> (f ^^ i) x"
            proof
              assume eq: "f ((f ^^ i) x) = (f ^^ i) x"
              have pe: "p - i + i = p" using ip by arith
              have hy: "(f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ i) x) = (f ^^ i) x"
                by (rule iter_fixed[where f = f and y = "(f ^^ i) x" and k = "p - i", OF eq])
              have s1: "(f ^^ p) x = (f ^^ ((p - i) + i)) x" by (simp only: pe)
              have s2: "(f ^^ ((p - i) + i)) x = (f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ i) x)"
                by (simp only: funpow_add comp_apply)
              have xi: "x = (f ^^ i) x"
              proof -
                have "x = (f ^^ p) x" by (rule px[symmetric])
                also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ ((p - i) + i)) x" by (rule s1)
                also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ i) x)" by (rule s2)
                also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ i) x" by (rule hy)
                finally show ?thesis .
              qed
              have "f x = f ((f ^^ i) x)" using xi by (rule arg_cong)
              also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ i) x" by (rule eq)
              also have "\<dots> = x" using xi by (rule sym)
              finally have "f x = x" .
              with nfix show False by contradiction
            qed
          qed
          have lt_ne: "\<And>i j. i < j \<Longrightarrow> j < p \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ i) x \<noteq> (f ^^ j) x"
          proof -
            fix i j :: nat
            assume ij: "i < j" and jp: "j < p"
            show "(f ^^ i) x \<noteq> (f ^^ j) x"
            proof
              assume eq: "(f ^^ i) x = (f ^^ j) x"
              have pj: "p - j + j = p" using jp by arith
              have B: "(f ^^ (p - j)) ((f ^^ j) x) = x"
              proof -
                have "(f ^^ (p - j)) ((f ^^ j) x) = (f ^^ ((p - j) + j)) x"
                  by (simp only: funpow_add comp_apply)
                also have "\<dots> = x" by (simp only: pj px)
                finally show ?thesis .
              qed
              have C: "(f ^^ (p - j)) ((f ^^ i) x) = (f ^^ (p - j + i)) x"
                by (simp only: funpow_add comp_apply)
              have D1: "(f ^^ (p - j)) ((f ^^ i) x) = (f ^^ (p - j)) ((f ^^ j) x)"
                by (simp only: eq)
              have D: "(f ^^ (p - j + i)) x = x" by (simp only: C[symmetric] D1 B)
              have m0: "0 < p - j + i" using jp by arith
              have mlt: "p - j + i < p" using ij jp by arith
              have "f x = x" by (rule prime_orbit_fixed[OF pp px D m0 mlt])
              with nfix show False by contradiction
            qed
          qed
          have inj_O: "inj_on (\<lambda>i. (f ^^ i) x) {..<p}"
          proof (rule inj_onI)
            fix i j assume hi: "i \<in> {..<p}" and hj: "j \<in> {..<p}"
              and eq: "(f ^^ i) x = (f ^^ j) x"
            have ip: "i < p" using hi by simp
            have jp: "j < p" using hj by simp
            show "i = j"
            proof (rule linorder_cases[of i j])
              assume "i < j"
              have hne: "(f ^^ i) x \<noteq> (f ^^ j) x" by (rule lt_ne[OF this jp])
              from hne eq show ?thesis by contradiction
            next
              assume "i = j"
              then show ?thesis .
            next
              assume "j < i"
              have hne: "(f ^^ j) x \<noteq> (f ^^ i) x" by (rule lt_ne[OF this ip])
              have eq': "(f ^^ j) x = (f ^^ i) x" by (rule sym[OF eq])
              from hne eq' show ?thesis by contradiction
            qed
          qed
          have cardO: "card Orb = p" unfolding Orb_def by (simp add: card_image inj_O)
          have O_sub: "Orb \<subseteq> X" unfolding Orb_def by (simp add: image_subset_iff orb_in)
          have fin_diff: "finite (X - Orb)" by (rule finite_Diff[OF fin])
          have le: "card Orb \<le> card X" by (rule card_mono[OF fin O_sub])
          have d: "card (X - Orb) = card X - card Orb" by (rule card_Diff_subset[OF finO O_sub])
          have pl: "p \<le> card X" using le cardO by simp
          have split: "card X = card (X - Orb) + p" using d cardO pl by arith
          have not_fix_O: "\<And>y. y \<in> Orb \<Longrightarrow> f y \<noteq> y"
          proof -
            fix y assume yO: "y \<in> Orb"
            have yO': "y \<in> (\<lambda>i. (f ^^ i) x) ` {..<p}" using yO by (simp only: Orb_def)
            obtain i where yi: "y = (\<lambda>i. (f ^^ i) x) i" and ip: "i \<in> {..<p}"
              by (rule imageE[OF yO'])
            have ilt: "i < p" using ip by simp
            show "f y \<noteq> y" unfolding yi by (rule no_fix[OF ilt])
          qed
          have fix_eq: "{y \<in> X - Orb. f y = y} = {y \<in> X. f y = y}"
          proof (intro equalityI subsetI)
            fix y assume hy: "y \<in> {y \<in> X - Orb. f y = y}"
            then show "y \<in> {y \<in> X. f y = y}" by simp
          next
            fix y assume hy: "y \<in> {y \<in> X. f y = y}"
            have yX: "y \<in> X" using hy by simp
            have yf: "f y = y" using hy by simp
            have yO: "y \<notin> Orb"
            proof
              assume "y \<in> Orb"
              then have "f y \<noteq> y" by (rule not_fix_O)
              with yf show False by contradiction
            qed
            from yX yO yf show "y \<in> {y \<in> X - Orb. f y = y}" by simp
          qed
          have sub': "f ` (X - Orb) \<subseteq> X - Orb"

      case 0
      show ?case

        fix X :: "'a set"
        assume cX: "card X \<le> 0" and fin: "finite X"
        have c0: "card X = 0" using cX by simp
        have "X = {}" using c0 fin by simp
        then show "card X mod p = card {x\<in>X. f x = x} mod p" by simp
      qed
    next

      have ih: "\<forall>X. card X \<le> n \<longrightarrow> finite X \<longrightarrow> f ` X \<subseteq> X \<longrightarrow>
          (\<forall>x\<in>X. (f ^^ p) x = x) \<longrightarrow> card X mod p = card {x\<in>X. f x = x} mod p"

      show ?case

        fix X :: "'a set"

        show "card X mod p = card {x\<in>X. f x = x} mod p"

          case True
          have "{x\<in>X. f x = x} = X" using True by simp
          then show ?thesis by simp
        next
          case False
          have ex: "\<exists>x\<in>X. f x \<noteq> x" using False by (simp add: Ball_def Bex_def)
          obtain x where xX: "x \<in> X" and nfix: "f x \<noteq> x" by (rule bexE[OF ex])
